home.heroTitle: Trusted job opportunities for our community, with full privacy
home.heroLead: Register your skills once and see the jobs that fit your experience. Employers contact you only after you express interest.
home.how1: Short steps that save automatically. Finish any time.
home.how2: Jobs are ranked by fit and marked suitable or near match.
home.how3: With your consent, the employer receives your profile and contacts you.
home.privacyBody: Employers only see your data after you express interest and consent. Employer identities are never shown on jobs, and every employer is reviewed by an admin before posting.

login.title: Log in
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Log in with the new password.
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please log in again.

signup.title: Create a job seeker account
signup.lead: We will send a code to your personal email to activate the account.
signup.pwHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
signup.consentShare: I agree that my profile, CV and contact details are shared with an employer only when I express interest in their job.
signup.consentTerms: I agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.codeHint: The code is valid for 10 minutes. If you cannot find it, check your spam folder.
verify.verified: Your account is active. Welcome to Sanad.
verify.missingEmail: We do not know which email to verify. Sign up again or log in.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a code to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this email is registered, a code will arrive within a minute.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Enter the code we sent to
reset.resend: No code? Send a new one

change.title: Change password
change.lead: Choose a new password for your account.
change.forcedNote: This is a temporary password. Change it now to continue; you will not be asked again.

employer.title: Employer dashboard
employer.signupNote: An admin reviews your account before your first job goes live. Your name, organization and contact details are never shown to job seekers.
employer.name: Name
employer.btypeHint: Your type of organization: government, semi-government, private, non-profit, individual or international.
employer.pwHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
employer.consentTerms: I agree to the terms of use and privacy policy.
employer.pendingLead: An admin is reviewing your details. We will email you once approved.
employer.postDisabled: You can post jobs once your account is approved.
employer.rejectedLead: An admin reviewed your details and did not approve the account. Contact the platform administration if you have a question.
employer.suspendedLead: You cannot post jobs right now. Contact the platform administration.
employer.noJobs: You have not posted any job yet.
employer.loadFailed: Could not load the data. Try again.
employer.postNote: Job seekers never see your name or organization. They see only the title, sector, location and requirements.
employer.descHint: Describe duties and skills. Keywords are used for matching.
employer.publishedToast: Job published and visible to job seekers.
employer.jobClosedNote: This job is closed and cannot be edited.
employer.applicantsNote: You can see these people because they expressed interest and consented to sharing. Contact them directly.
employer.noApplicantsToHire: There are no applicants for this job yet, so "Hired via platform" cannot be chosen.
employer.closeWarn: After closing, the job becomes "Unavailable" and accepts no new interest requests.

approvals.title: Employer approvals
approvals.note: Employer details are confidential and visible to admins only.
approvals.name: Name
approvals.rejectHint: The reason is sent to the employer by email.
approvals.approvedToast: {org} is approved and has been emailed.
approvals.rejectedToast: {org} is rejected and has been emailed.

lookups.title: Lookup lists
lookups.lead: Users see these lists in Arabic or English depending on their language.
lookups.codeHint: Capital Latin letters, digits and _. Unique, and not shown to users.
lookups.isoHint: Two-letter ISO country code, for example SA.
lookups.rankHint: A unique number; higher means more education. Used in matching.
lookups.disabledToast: Item disabled; it is no longer offered in forms.
lookups.inactiveNote: A disabled item stays on existing records but is no longer offered in forms.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.newAdminNote: A temporary password is emailed; they must change it at first login.
users.usernameHint: Can be used instead of the email to sign in.
users.createdToast: Account created; the temporary password was sent to {email}.

user.suspendBody: They will not be able to sign in, and their sessions end. You can reactivate the account later.
user.deleteBody: The account is removed from the platform; the audit log keeps its history. This cannot be undone here.
user.sysNote: The system account cannot be deleted, suspended or have its role changed. Only its email can change.
user.ownNote: This is your account. Change your email and password from "My account".
user.superOnly: Only a super admin can manage admin accounts.
user.yourPasswordHint: To confirm. A notice is sent to the previous address.
user.noProfile: The profile has not been started yet.
user.revealNote: Viewing is recorded in the audit log.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.note: Read-only: nobody can edit or delete entries. Encrypted fields are masked.

settings.title: Matching settings
settings.lead: Weights of the matching factors and the label thresholds. Saving recomputes every score.
settings.weightsHint: They add up to 100. Current total: {sum}
settings.savedToast: Settings saved; scores are being recomputed in the background.

export.title: Confirm export
export.body: The file includes private data: ID numbers, dar and fakhdh, and contact details. Enter your password to confirm. The export is recorded in the audit log.
export.filtered: The file follows the current filters.
export.toast: The Excel file is ready, and the export was recorded in the audit log.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed or the page was removed.

validation.passwordPolicy: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
validation.consent: Please tick this consent to continue.
validation.fixErrors: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
validation.saudiMobile: Enter a valid Saudi mobile number starting with 05.
validation.nationalId: The national ID is 10 digits starting with 1 or 2.
validation.passport: The passport number is 5 to 20 letters or digits.
validation.dateFuture: The date cannot be in the future.
validation.dateOrder: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.dateBeforeBirth: This date is before your date of birth.
validation.gradYear: The graduation year is not plausible.
validation.lookup: Choose a value from the list.

validation.contactRequired: Enter a phone number or an email.
validation.lookupCode: Use capital Latin letters, digits and _ only.
validation.isoCode: The country code is two Latin letters (ISO), for example SA.

validation.rankTaken: This rank is used by another level.
validation.usernameTaken: This username is used by another account.

validation.weightsSum: The weights must add up to 100.
validation.thresholdOrder: The "near" threshold must be lower than the "suitable" one.

profile.title: My professional profile

profile.doneToast: Profile complete. Jobs are ranked by how well they fit you.
profile.loadFailed: Your profile could not be loaded. Please try again.
profile.idHint: Stored encrypted and never shown to employers.
profile.idKeep: Saved: {masked}. Leave empty to keep it.
profile.affHint: Both lists are maintained by the platform admins. Contact them if yours is missing.
profile.affEmpty: The admins have not added the dar and fakhdh lists yet. You can continue.
profile.contactHint: Employers see these only after you express interest in their job.
profile.hasExp: Do you have previous work experience?
profile.posHint: Add every position you have held, latest first.
profile.verifierHint: Name and phone or email of someone who can confirm your experience.

profile.analysisNoCv: Upload your CV to see the analysis here.
profile.sectorFix: You can correct it if it is not accurate.
